comments.body: Intent Gate: intent-aligned (manual). The Jira bridge's stated purpose per outbound-bridge.yml header ('Pushes local ticket changes to Jira') and inbound-bridge.yml ('Pulls Jira changes into local ticket system') is bidirectional sync. Both symptoms (status-not-syncing, type=epic-not-creating) directly contradict that intent. No conflicting callers — the sync IS the contract.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: Fixed in commit 72901ba238. Root cause B (no SYNC marker on inbound CREATE) addressed by bridge/_inbound_api.write_create_events writing SYNC.json marker + self-heal pass for legacy CREATE-without-SYNC tickets. Root cause A (single-pathed outbound dispatch) addressed by adding cron schedule to outbound-bridge.yml. After this commit lands on main and inbound bridge runs once, jira-dig-1575/1576 will get backfilled SYNC markers and the queued in_progress STATUS event will push to Jira on next outbound run.
